legend-julier-pass-road.slogan: Julier Pass Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-julier-pass-road.story: curated scenic road. high alpine, lakes, Roman route. From Tiefencastel it runs 30 km to Silvaplana; allow about 33 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,450 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
